leads_org_phone_uidx.name: leads_org_phone_uidx
leads_org_phone_uidx.where: "leads"."deleted_at" is null and "leads"."phone_e164" is not null

jobs_org_source_estimate_uidx.name: jobs_org_source_estimate_uidx
jobs_org_source_estimate_uidx.where: "jobs"."source_estimate_id" is not null and "jobs"."deleted_at" is null

jobs_window_check.name: jobs_window_check
jobs_window_check.value: "jobs"."scheduled_end" is null or "jobs"."scheduled_start" is null or "jobs"."scheduled_end" >= "jobs"."scheduled_start"

invoices_org_scope_job_uidx.name: invoices_org_scope_job_uidx
invoices_org_scope_job_uidx.where: "invoices"."scope_job_id" is not null and "invoices"."deleted_at" is null and "invoices"."status" <> 'void'

invoices_org_source_job_uidx.name: invoices_org_source_job_uidx
invoices_org_source_job_uidx.where: "invoices"."source_job_id" is not null and "invoices"."deleted_at" is null

notifications_related_one_check.name: notifications_related_one_check
notifications_related_one_check.value: not ("notifications"."related_invoice_id" is not null and "notifications"."related_estimate_id" is not null)

lead_notes_attachment_shape_check.name: lead_notes_attachment_shape_check
lead_notes_attachment_shape_check.value:
("lead_notes"."attachment_path" is null) = ("lead_notes"."attachment_type" is null)
          and ("lead_notes"."attachment_path" is null) = ("lead_notes"."attachment_name" is null)

time_entries_kind_shape_check.name: time_entries_kind_shape_check
time_entries_kind_shape_check.value:
("time_entries"."kind" in ('job', 'travel', 'break', 'shop') and "time_entries"."start_time" is not null and "time_entries"."minutes" is null)
          or ("time_entries"."kind" in ('pto', 'vacation', 'sick', 'holiday') and "time_entries"."start_time" is null and "time_entries"."end_time" is null and "time_entries"."minutes" between 1 and 1440 and "time_entries"."running" = false)

painting_room_quantities_height_ck.name: painting_room_quantities_height_ck
painting_room_quantities_height_ck.value: "painting_room_quantities"."height_in" is null or ("painting_room_quantities"."kind" in ('baseboard_lnft','crown_lnft') and "painting_room_quantities"."height_in" > 0 and "painting_room_quantities"."height_in" <= 24)

site_captures_pitch_ck.name: site_captures_pitch_ck
site_captures_pitch_ck.value: ("site_captures"."surface" = 'flat' and "site_captures"."pitch_rise" is null) or ("site_captures"."surface" = 'pitched' and "site_captures"."pitch_rise" between 1 and 24)

team_messages_attachment_shape_check.name: team_messages_attachment_shape_check
team_messages_attachment_shape_check.value:
("team_messages"."attachment_path" is null) = ("team_messages"."attachment_type" is null)
          and ("team_messages"."attachment_path" is null) = ("team_messages"."attachment_bytes" is null)

team_threads_shape_check.name: team_threads_shape_check
team_threads_shape_check.value:
("team_threads"."kind" = 'dm' and "team_threads"."dm_key" is not null and "team_threads"."title" is null)
          or ("team_threads"."kind" = 'group' and "team_threads"."dm_key" is null and "team_threads"."title" is not null)

purchase_orders_org_num_uidx.name: purchase_orders_org_num_uidx
purchase_orders_org_num_uidx.where: deleted_at is null and num is not null
